heroMetrics.label: Google reviews
heroMetrics.note: Your 4.9★ rating is best-in-class. The problem is velocity: zero new reviews in the last 30 days, while three local competitors all added reviews in the same window. This is the fastest lever you have.

heroMetrics.label: Facebook & Instagram Ads · 30d
heroMetrics.note: Superior Spray was put in front of 51,379 people across Central Florida in the last 30 days (up from ~49K) on $1,126 of ad spend. Strong top-of-funnel reach that keeps you top of mind — we just turned off the low-quality 'Audience Network' placements so more of that spend now reaches real prospects.

heroMetrics.label: Calls · 30d
heroMetrics.note: Web calls have stabilized at 37 (from 40 the prior month) — the sharp earlier drop has leveled off now that conversion tracking is cleaned up and counting real calls only. Next focus: turn that ad reach into booked calls and get website form submissions tracked so no lead goes uncounted.

pillars.name: Google Business Profile
pillars.note: 4.9★, 449 reviews, 376+ photos — a strong profile. Docked because zero new reviews landed in 30 days (competitors added 3–13 each in the same window) and Google Posts have been quiet since June 8.

pillars.name: On-site conversion
pillars.note: Phone + click-to-call in the header, a free-estimate form, a clear primary CTA, valid SSL, fast server response. Only gaps: the site's form-submit isn't firing a tracked event yet, and full mobile PageSpeed not yet measured.

pillars.name: Local map visibility
pillars.note: Strong organically (#3 for "pest control Lakeland"). As a service-area business with no public storefront, your Google map presence is driven by review velocity, Google Posts, and GBP optimization rather than a storefront pin. Biggest levers now: more reviews and a steady posting cadence.

hygiene.note: Ranks well for the head term; service-specific pages need on-page work. Kept healthy in the background — not sold as what rings the phone.

thisWeeksMove.label: Rebuild your review velocity
thisWeeksMove.body: You added 0 new reviews in the last 30 days while Anti-Pesto (556, +5), Country Boy (485, +3), and Dave's (336, +13) all pulled further ahead. Texting your recent customers for a review is the fastest, cheapest lever you have — and let's restart Google Posts, which have been quiet since June 8.

lumenDid: Reviewed your FieldRoutes lead sources for the last 30 days: Google search is driving your bookable leads, while Facebook shows next to none we can directly attribute (a portion come in as N/A or phone call-ins). That is exactly why we are doubling down on Google Ads and the website — Facebook earns its keep as top-of-funnel awareness, but search is what rings the phone

Rebuilt your Google Ads: lifted Ad Strength from Poor to Good, split Search into focused General Pest Control + Termite ad groups, and trimmed targeting to your 4 core counties (Polk, Orange, Brevard, Hillsborough) so you stop paying for Tampa/Orlando clicks
Turned off the Meta 'Audience Network' placements that were driving low-quality clicks, so more of your ad spend reaches real Central Florida prospects
Cleaned up your conversion tracking — GA4 now counts real phone calls (37 in the last 30 days), not inflated page views
Locked three Pest Detectives podcast shoot dates with Kevin & Sean (Aug 26, Sep 23, Oct 21) and scheduled an August newsletter resend to 6,182 subscribers who hadn't opened yet

ledger.title: Rebuild review velocity — text recent customers

ledger.title: Add form-fill tracking to your site
ledger.detail: Your site isn't sending a form-submission event, so quote requests can't be counted yet. Quick fix, real visibility win.
